en.title: Duality's Afterglow, Blade of Severance
en.premise: Once a family’s pride, the famed sword was shattered into two on a tragic night, splitting between twin brothers. One became a swordsman consumed by the flames of vengeance; the other a monk severing karma. Amid the chaos of a war for dominance, the two shards are drawn together again, setting the gears of fate in motion. Bloodlines demand destiny, while individual souls seek justice, colliding on the fractured blade.

zh.title: 双极余晖，断裂之刃
zh.premise: 曾经象征家族荣耀的名刀，在一次悲剧之夜被折成两半，分给了双子兄弟。一个被复仇之火吞噬的剑客，另一个则是断绝因果的僧侣。在乱世权力争夺的漩涡中，两块碎片再次相互吸引，开启了命运的齿轮。血脉所求的宿命与个体灵魂追求的正义，在破碎的刀刃上激烈碰撞。
